header_summary:
The Bitcoin development community has achieved notable progress with the 6th public release of the Backbone project, featuring enhanced quality assurance and the successful integration of bitcoind's Python functional tests. This new version supports multi-daemon processes and has improved the backbone-cli controls for the main daemon, contributing significantly to the project's foundational structure aimed at fostering a real peer-to-peer Bitcoin economy. For further exploration or contributions, the updated code is available at [bitcoinbackbone.org](http://bitcoinbackbone.org).

The latest versions of Bitcoin Core, 30.3 and 29.4, have been released, incorporating numerous enhancements such as bug fixes, performance improvements, and extended compatibility with recent operating systems. These updates also address technical issues like excessive disk operations and improve the system's overall reliability and efficiency. Users are encouraged to download the new versions from [Bitcoin Core 30.3](https://bitcoincore.org/bin/bitcoin-core-30.3/) and [Bitcoin Core 29.4](https://bitcoincore.org/bin/bitcoin-core-29.4/) respectively, and report any issues on the [GitHub Issues page](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues).

Additionally, the Electrum desktop application has introduced a new plugin, the Electrum Silent Payments Sender, designed to enhance user experience by allowing direct transactions to Silent Payment addresses. This plugin, compatible with Electrum version 4.6.0 and above, supports various networks and input types while focusing on maintaining security through rigorous verification processes. Interested users can download the plugin from the [Releases page on GitHub](https://github.com/ZenulAbidin/electrum-silent-payments-sender/releases/).

recent_posts.title: Bitcoin Core 30.3 released
recent_posts.summary:
- Bitcoin Core version 30.3 introduces new features, bug fixes, and performance enhancements.
- Upgrade process varies; shut down old versions fully and follow system-specific installation instructions.
- This release supports Linux Kernel 3.17+, macOS 13+, and Windows 10+; older systems are less tested.

recent_posts.title: Bitcoin Core 29.4 released
recent_posts.summary:
- Bitcoin Core version 29.4 offers numerous fixes and enhancements, now available for download.

- The update is compatible with various modern operating systems and improves system protocols.

recent_posts.title: Silent Payments Sender - BIP352 plugin for Electrum
recent_posts.summary: - The new Electrum plugin integrates BIP352 Silent Payments, enhancing user functionality.  - It supports various networks and input types, but lacks multisig and hardware wallet compatibility.  - Installation involves downloading from GitHub, verifying the SHA256 hash, and enabling via Electrum.
